# Appealing a fine

A borrower may appeal any overdue fine or lost-item charge within 60 days of the
date the charge posted to the account. Appeals submitted after 60 days are
declined without review.

An appeal is filed on the paper form held at every service desk, or by writing
to the circulation supervisor. The appeal must state the charge, the item, and
the ground being claimed. Three grounds are recognised:

- the item was returned on time and the return was mis-scanned
- the borrower was ill or bereaved during the loan period
- the branch was closed unexpectedly on the due date

A supervisor decides an appeal within 10 working days and the decision is
recorded against the account. A declined appeal may be escalated once, to the
head of public services, whose decision is final.

Appeals do not pause accrual. An overdue fine continues to accrue while an
appeal is pending, and is refunded in full if the appeal succeeds.
